summaries.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **DeepSeek-Coder** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：To address this, we introduce the DeepSeek-Coder series, a range of open-source code models with sizes from 1.3B to 33B, trained from scratch on 2 trillion tokens。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **1.3B, 33B, 2 trillion tokens**。实验设计与验证细节：To address this, we introduce the DeepSeek-Coder series, a range of open-source code models with sizes from 1.3B to 33B, trained from scratch on 2...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our extensive evaluations demonstrate that DeepSeek-Coder not only achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source code models across multiple benchmarks but also surpasses...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 71 赞，出自 DeepSeek），本工作修正了对 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 68 赞），本工作为突破 **视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Rethinking Patch Dependence for Masked Autoencoders
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Rethinking Patch Dependence for Masked** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖训练与强化学习（Training & RL）。核心论点主张：To this end, we propose a novel pretraining framework: Cross-Attention Masked Autoencoders (CrossMAE)。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **ImageNet, COCO**。实验设计与验证细节：Our investigations suggest that self-attention between mask patches is not essential for learning good representations。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **3.7× less**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Code and models:）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 26 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: FP6-LLM: Efficiently Serving Large Language Models Through FP6-Centric Algorithm-System Co-Design
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**高效推理与系统**（Efficiency & Sys）赛道，属于系统与工程框架。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **FP6-LLM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Six-bit quantization (FP6) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To address these problems, we propose TC-FPx, the first full-stack GPU kernel design scheme with unified Tensor Core support of float-point weights for various quantization...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **70b, single GPU**。实验设计与验证细节：It is challenging to support FP6 quantization on GPUs due to (1) unfriendly memory access of model weights with irregular bit-width and (2) high...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **1.69x, 2.65x**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments show that FP6-LLM enables the inference of LLaMA-70b using only a single GPU, achieving 1.69x-2.65x higher normalized inference throughput than the FP16 baseline）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 20 赞），本工作证明了系统级编排/底层执行优化在 **高效推理与系统** 落地中的决定性收益；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Deconstructing Denoising Diffusion Models for Self-Supervised Learning
summaries.perspective:

Diffusion Models (DDM), Denoising Autoencoder (DAE) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this study, we examine the representation learning abilities of Denoising Diffusion Models (DDM) that were originally purposed for image generation。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we introduce Open-World Mobile Manipulation System, a full-stack approach to tackle realistic articulated object operation, e.g. real-world doors,...。

summaries.title: Genie: Achieving Human Parity in Content-Grounded Datasets Generation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **Genie** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖合成数据（Synthetic Data），并引入 Long-Form Question-Answering (LFQA) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To address this gap, we propose Genie, a novel method for automatically generating high-quality content-grounded data。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Furthermore, we compare models trained on our data with models trained on human-written data -- ELI5 and ASQA for LFQA and CNN-DailyMail for Summarization。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that our models are on par with or outperforming models trained on human-generated data and consistently outperforming them in faithfulness）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 8 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、科学智能 (生物/化学/物理/医疗)** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
